jobs.description_text: Territory: Detroit, MI & Indiana Natera is seeking an experienced Clinical Oncology Specialist (COS) to join our specialized Genitourinary (GU) Oncology sales team. This high-impact, tumor-specific role will focus on driving adoption and growth of Signatera™, Natera's personalized, tumor-informed molecular residual disease (MRD) test , across the GU Oncology landscape. jobs.title: AI Resident
jobs.description_text: The AI Residency Program The AI Residency Program is designed for exceptional early-career researchers and engineers who want to tackle some of the hardest problems in robotics and AI. Residents will work alongside a deeply technical team on core challenges in embodied physical intelligence, including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, World Models, World Action Models, and 3D foundation models, as well as the full stack of real-world learning—from efficient data collection systems and simulation to reinforcement learning and deployment on physical robots. This is a hands-on residency for people who want to do ambitious work with real consequences: building learning systems that connect perception, reasoning, and action in service of capable, deployable robots. What makes this program different is the direct connection between research and real-world deployment. Residents work with actual RoboForce robots, iterate quickly between simulation and physical execution, and contribute to systems designed for real use. The problems are hard, the standards are high, and the goal is to build systems that matter outside the lab. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers. You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. jobs.title: In Office RN- NY Licensed
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Our New York in-office RNs work collaboratively with one another and with every member of their office-based care team. With continuous access to support from our Virtual Medical Team, we provide accessible, comprehensive, and coordinated care grounded in longitudinal, healing relationships. As a Registered Nurse, you’ll report to the RN Manager based off your specific region of New York and play a critical role in delivering high-quality primary care. Your responsibilities center on clinical nursing care, patient education, care coordination, and continuous clinical excellence across the lifespan. In New York, the RN is an essential member of the care team, helping ensure care is delivered safely and effectively in accordance with applicable nursing regulations, scope-of-practice requirements, and clinical guidelines. Our clinics provide broad, comprehensive primary care, and the RN plays a key role in bringing this model to life - supporting patients, partnering closely with providers, and ensuring continuity and coordination across the care journey.
